messages.en: Has that party joined the opposition bloc yet?
Not yet. They're only just getting ready to discuss it with the party leadership.
I'm thinking of getting a bob. Do you think it'd suit me?
Definitely! Show the hairdresser a photo first. It'll make it easier to explain what you want.

senses.en_definition: Stupid; slow to understand or learn, or lacking good judgment.
Used in expressions meaning to feign ignorance or ignore something, chiefly buat bodoh and buat-buat bodoh.

collocations.en: act as if nothing is wrong; ignore it

senses.en_definition: A coarse slang exclamation or intensifier expressing a strong reaction, without necessarily calling anyone stupid.

collocations.en: so damn funny; a stupid joke, depending on context

messages.en: Which shop are we talking about? You didn't even send me the location.
Come on, don't play dumb. I already sent it in the group chat earlier.
Oh, you're right. I didn't notice it earlier. Sorry!
I read that message in the group chat. Has that shop really closed down?
That's just a made-up story. I bought bread there just now.
